record.question: Which of the following is appropriate with procedure for conducting negotiations?
options: In case where negotiation becomes necessary to do so, it is restricted only to the 1st lowest tenderer.
In case if L-1 withdraws or found ineligible after opening of tenders, then L-2 should be negotiated.
It is not necessary for accepting authority to obtain prior approval of next higher authority whenever negotiation becomes necessary in urgent situation.
Authority recommending negotiations are not required to give justification for negotiation.
record.explanation: If L-1 withdraws or is ineligible, L-2 should be negotiated.
